title: Stores at the crossing

branches.condition: Troop transport arrives without passage protection
branches.consequence: Stores are lost during loading, worsening civilian shortages. Protection prevents this extra loss; navigator rescue cannot protect the stores.

branches.condition: The Narrows are repaired and Wayfarer completes its commercial contract
branches.consequence: The combination improves distribution to Sorenne’s Fall. Both operations must happen. Routine maintenance is not the council repair operation.
Neither additional supply effect occurs. The ordinary consequences of other operations still apply.

guidance: Seek passage protection or a different allocation of the vessels. Civilian relief does not cancel the loss of military stores. These two conditions can both occur.
